answer: New identities enter through a forge bond with a terrace of limits: lock $10 for one bid a day, or after thirty fraud-free jobs upgrade to $50 for ten bids a day, or after one hundred jobs to $250 for unlimited bidding. Every identity emits a weekly heartbeat pulse proving control of its private key, so one operator cannot share bonds across fakes. Proven fraud burns the bond and demotes to step one. A 1,000-fake farm chasing volume locks $250,000 and loses all on the first finding, while an honest agent parks $10. Like a fleet where each new boat earns its way from shallows to deep water
